finding_title: Climate Disaster Damage Granger-Causes Material Political Conflict
empirical_evidence: Disaster economic damage (disaster_economic_damage_usd) statistically precedes material conflict (material_conflict_annual_sum) across lags 1, 2, and 3 (F = 6.53). Extreme climate events trigger measurable socio-political conflict escalations in subsequent years.

finding_title: Temperature Anomalies Granger-Cause Political Stability Shifts
empirical_evidence: Temperature anomaly (temp_anomaly_celsius) statistically causes changes in national political stability (goldstein_annual_mean) at 2-year and 3-year lags (F = 4.83). Climate thermal stress directly precedes shifts in baseline political stability.

finding_title: Political Stability Momentum Granger-Causes Renewable Energy Transition
empirical_evidence: Stability momentum (stability_momentum_annual_mean) strongly Granger-causes increases in renewable energy share (renewable_energy_pct_share) at lags 2 and 3 (F = 10.59). Sustained political stability is an essential prerequisite for clean energy adoption.

finding_title: Government Debt Granger-Causes Renewable Energy Investment
empirical_evidence: Government debt to GDP ratio (gov_debt_gdp) Granger-causes renewable energy share at lag 2 (F = 3.92), reflecting state-financed fiscal energy transition programs.

finding_title: Environment Features Statistically Significantly Improve 5-Year GDP Growth Forecasting
empirical_evidence: Adding Environmental features (Eco+Env) to Economy-only features achieves a statistically significant Diebold-Mariano RMSE reduction (p = 0.0056) when predicting 5-year GDP per capita growth (gdp_pc_growth_5y_fwd). Long-term economic growth models gain verified predictive power from climate risk metrics.

finding_title: 10-Year Rolling Temperature Anomaly Predicts 1-Year Ahead Political Stability
empirical_evidence: In multi-domain LightGBM models for predicting 1-year forward Goldstein political stability (goldstein_annual_mean_1y_fwd), temp_anomaly_celsius_roll_mean_10y ranks as the #2 feature driver (141.4 score) behind past stability.

finding_title: Macroeconomic Indicators Drive Climate Disaster Economic Damage Predictions
empirical_evidence: Current account balance (current_account_gdp) and inflation rate rank alongside CO2 emissions as the top 3 predictive drivers for forecasting next-year climate disaster economic damages (disaster_economic_damage_usd_target_h1).

finding_title: Multi-Domain Twin Analog Ensembles Reliably Match Forward Trajectories
empirical_evidence: Matching scale-invariant Rank-Euclidean state vectors across Economy, Politics, and Environment successfully identifies historical twin countries (e.g. USA 2015 matching CAN 2012, GBR 2011) that display tightly convergent forward trajectories in GDP growth and carbon emission trajectories.
